name: Spaceship 6469dbc4 on the 2-uniform tiling k2-004
description: A period-5 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-004 (touching neighbours), 5 to 9 cells, moving one lattice step every 5 generations (c/5). It runs the same way in the 512 rules from B3/S356 to B3,7,8,9,10/S0,3,5,6,7,8,9,10; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Its live cells also evolve the same way on k2-003, k3-010 and k3-016, where the empty tiles around them have other neighbour counts. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 4 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
